intro: Stonegear's Search is an Alliance directive directing adventurous travelers to Pilot Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. The enthusiastic siege engine operator has caught wind of an exotic mineral and seeks a daring explorer to track down fresh fuel for his tank's ordnance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should! And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!
He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him. If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello friend. You're here about the task I have, eh? It's good to see a young traveler like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
